_comment: Sprint I3 T3 — non-lexical fillers hidden from a conversation's displayed transcript, per language, lower-cased. raw_text keeps every word; hidden words keep their timings. nlp-service (stages/disfluency.py) and note-service (meeting_doc/verify.normalise_quote) each assert their table equals this file, so a quote taken from the displayed text still matches the raw one.
